summary: Raced single-unit carts for shared WIDGET stock (10 units) across two Medusa servers. In all 13 runs reserved_matches_reservations failed: the level's reserved_quantity (e.g. 7 to 9) disagreed with the live reservation sum of the completed orders. In one run no_oversell also failed, with 11 orders for 10 units. The cause is in inventory-module createReservationItems_: it reads inventory levels through ensureInventoryLevels with a plain list (no row lock) and then writes reserved_quantity as the stale value plus the adjustment, so concurrent reservations from two servers (where the in-memory lock does not serialize) lose increments. Other checks (one_order_per_cart, no_orphaned_orders, no_missing_orders) passed.
